name: Anima App
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
For professional design, product, and R&D teams, Anima offers professional vibe coding.
For agents, AgentGrid.io is a shared workspace for humans and agents to share files and collaborate.

At AnimaApp.com - We offer on-brand Vibe-coding, anyone in the team can build fast without breaking your look and feel. No Figma skills required. Anima generates clean and developer-friendly code. So your prototypes could also be used for handoff.

Three ways to start
- Figma to Code → Instantly generate clean React, HTML, or Vue code from Figma designs.
- Website to Code (Cloning / Remixing) → Import any live website and turn it into editable code.
- Prompt to Design (coming soon) → Generate high-end UI directly from natural language prompts, automatically styled to your brand.

Key features
- Start at AnimaApp.com to bring your design or your website to Anima
- Chat in Anima playground to iterate on your project's code while staying on-brand
- Handoff playground link to engineering
- Or, download code to continue with Clause code ot Cursor
- Or, publish a public link to share with clients or stakeholders
one_liner: Anima - Design Agent | AgentGrid.io - Shared drive for humans & agents

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
1. Design is Code - Everyone can code with agents today; agents are speaking code natively, and there’s no point in drawing vectors when agents could build it.
2. Anima is the design agent in the swarm - Any agent could communicate with Anima via MCP and turn Figma into code, prompts into design, and clone existing websites to bridge the LLM design gaps.
3. Human & Agent hybrid teams - Agents become teammates, and as they do, they need ways to collaborate. Anima released [AgentGrid.io](https://AgentGrid.io) to make a shared workspace for humans and agents.
